answer: Each juror runs an onyx‑backed reputation mirror that records the median decision of the panel each epoch; when a new vote wanders away from that median by more than a calibrated delta, the protocol auto‑slashes the voter’s bonded stake. The slashing amount is fixed at 5 % of the stake per divergent vote, payable immediately, and the slashed tokens are burned, making each fake identity cost 0.05 × bond per epoch. An attacker must therefore lock 20 % of total stake per Sybil to keep any identity from being auto‑slashed, quickly draining resources as the panel expands.
